explanation: Delta source review found no actionable defect: TestMPLSIntegration_TransitIPv4Options sends valid RR and timestamp-with-address options, checks exact-fit forwarding before the oversized case, requires unchanged first-fragment options and Linux’s NOP replacement of non-copied options in later fragments, and requires the DF-set quotation to contain advanced pointers plus 10.0.0.1 in both reserved address slots, discriminating the reported before-003 failures without assuming a particular timestamp value. The revised mplsMTUFragments derives payload/header boundaries from IHL while retaining complete, nonoverlapping reconstruction and checksum/label/next-hop checks; mplsMTUError now locates quoted UDP after the actual option-bearing header without weakening the existing type, MTU, endpoint, source-policy or checksum assertions. run-carrier.py fails closed on command errors, timeout, malformed JSON, any skipped/failed named test, missing expected passes or changed binary bytes, requires all three parent tests and nine leaf cases in full mode, and creates a fresh evidence directory; this remains source review only, with Main’s reported native failures/build success accepted as given, and binary hashing plus uname still requiring the separately recorded source-to-kernel provenance before an implemented-capability claim.
